observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Urban outdoor settings including a turf soccer field, rooftops with water tanks, streets, and an illuminated modern walkway at night.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of men, women, and children; soloists and groups performing choreography.
observation.formation_and_space: Groups lined up on the soccer field, individual performers in various outdoor locations, and tight cluster formations.
observation.posture: Upright torso with soft knees during footwork, bending forward during hip movements.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, quick weight shifts, and bouncing on the beat, foot placement obscured in some wide shots.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing naturally, hands gestures, pointing, holding smoke flares or cell phones.
observation.hips_and_torso: Prominent hip rotation, twirling, and lower body isolations, especially during twerking movements by women in groups.
observation.partnering: Solo dancing alongside partners, occasional close positioning without complex partnering holds.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level with low squatting positions and deep hip drops, occasional turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual streetwear, athletic jerseys, caps, sunglasses, heavy chains; props include red smoke flares, motorcycles, and smartphones.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise footwork details are obscured by rapid camera cuts and low-resolution sampling in several wide-angle group shots.

signature_moments.what: Dancers shaking hips and twerking low to the ground surrounded by smoke flares.
Men stepping in sync with arm gestures on a turf field.
Group synchronizing arm pumps and leg bounces on the soccer field.
